# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The uploaded file is a large bulk of call recordings, but the overwhelming majority are **not real sales conversations** — they are transporter/trailer-booking calls (Raipur/Nagpur/Tirupati logistics), driver coordination, loading/crane chatter, document handovers (MTC/TC/tag/seal), payment-release follow-ups with transporters, wrong numbers, personal/non-business chatter (Vishal/Veer calls), and voicemail stubs. These were excluded per instructions.

A genuine, usable sales core does exist, spread across a few dozen calls with customers/dealers such as **Thangaraj Metfra, Tirupati Balasubramaniam, Thirumala Steel Vizag, V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Uniqcore Const (Balakrishnan), Vadivel T S (Sangeetha Traders), Vidveda Krishnasamy/Vignesh, V Sivakumar, Thirunelveli Rajkumar, Vijayakumar Annamalai, Velmurugan Subbaiyan, Vinodini Sharathi (Spec Engineering), Yuvaraj Elumalai, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, VJR Developers, Thirisha Murugan, United Gummudiponndi, Vigneshwaran Kalidoss (Stone Mart QC), V KUMAR, Venkatesan, Vishal Praful Mehta, UPPUTURI RAMAKRISHNA.**

These calls show BSC operating primarily as a **steel plate / structural steel / TMT bar trading and cutting (CTL/slitting) business**, selling both branded primary mill material (SAIL, Vizag/RINL, Tata) and "conversion"/secondary material, with heavy custom-cutting service as a differentiator. There is **no roofing-sheet business visible** in this corpus — do not assume it. Given the small share of true sales calls versus logistics/ops noise, conclusions below are grounded strictly in what appears, and kept tight.

## Products & brand ladder
- **TMT rebar (கம்பி):** Grades mentioned — Fe500, Fe500D, **Fe/SE 550D**, E250, E350, 250-grade plate. Fe500 is explicitly flagged as hard to get: *"500 கிடைக்காது sir... R&L தான் produce பண்ணுவாங்க... 3 months-ஆ R&L production இல்ல"* [500 grade not available; only RINL/R&L makes it, and they haven't produced in 3 months] — so **550D/Vizag (RINL) and SAIL are the default fallback brands** sold to customers who ask for 500.
- **Plates:** Thickness range 2–20+ mm, sizes referenced in meters/feet (e.g., 2.5m x 5m, 2000x6300, 2350, "4x8", "40 feet"). Checkered plates also sold. Grade options like 250 vs E350 are offered with a price delta: *"E350-ன்னா உங்களுக்கு அதோட ₹3000 extra வரும்"* [E350 costs ₹3000 more].
